expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, roots, state owners, protocols, or public operations. Extend one existing credential-write owner and add one focused test file.
minimum_design: Keep write_secret as the single credential-write owner, but separate temporary chmod, content write, atomic rename, and post-rename mode tightening into explicit gates. Reuse the existing file-mode and cleanup tests.
outcome: When a secret write reaches atomic rename, write_secret reports success even if a later best-effort chmod cannot change the installed inode. Setup, write, and rename failures still report failure and clean up temporary state.

reuse_decisions.name: write_secret
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing helper already centralizes every provider secret write. Separating durable commit from best-effort post-rename mode handling fixes the reported status without parallel write paths.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/secret-write.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: A focused fixture is needed to prove create, replacement, restrictive modes, cleanup, and invalid target failure.
